# S6.2 — one automated family, one component class (§05h §2.4–§4; R-2.9.5 6b · R-2.10.3⁴ · R-2.6.4⁴ · R-2.6.5⁴ · R-2.4.1⁴/2.4.2⁴/2.4.4⁴)

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s6.1b` (PR #92) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands Stage 6b — the first *automated* evolution family, restricted to
one component class per campaign, over the S6.1a state machine.

**`evolution_proposer` (new registry class + suite).** The class
registers in the corpus with its `conformance_suite_ref` back-patched;
the suite is the four-kind shape (static / contract / property /
executable). The conformance driver (`run_proposer_suite`) runs over a
`ProposerPort` — the `InProcessPort` drives the first-party variant;
the executable kind's out-of-process witness is
`hh-plugin-fixture --mode proposer` answering `declare` / `propose` /
`select_parent` over `plugin_abi/1` `invoke`, proven by a real
`hh-helper` spawn (`hh-varhost/tests/proposer.rs`).

**`AheProposer` — the AHE-shaped first-party variant.** Deterministic,
CPU-only, `uses_judge = no`, `instrument-grade`; the one-class bound is
construction-time (`AheProposer::new(class)`), so a variant *cannot*
emit outside it. Reads the evidence corpus (sibling-vs-base outcome
rows), binds a falsifiable `FailureHypothesis` to the named metric,
emits a tightening `ReplaceLeaf` diff (`evolution` origin provenance +
derived-from record) — or the typed `NoAddressableFailure`, never `[]`.
Typed failures: `ConstraintUnsatisfiable` / `BudgetExhausted` /
`CorpusUnreadable`. The proposer is a source, never a bypass — every
emission re-enters the campaign's S1 gates (ADR-0322 D1).

**Automated-family campaign gates.** `protocol = automated` requires
`proposer_variant_ref` + exactly one evolvable `target_class`; origin
is enforced both ways (`evolution` diffs under `automated`, human
diffs refused under it); `StaleBase` once the head moves; the
registered proposer variant itself is outside every target set
(`SelfModificationRefused`, X6); `coordination_delta = loosening`
refuses at S1 and the S7 re-check (CoordinationPolicy/topology are
evolvable under the same tightening grammar — ADR-0322 D3); G7 judge
selectors must be campaign-declared (`SelectorDeclaration` +
`calibration_ref` + `independent_of ∋ base` + the honeypot floor +
`audit_budget_ref`); G8 resolves each arm's `search_budget` to a
*complete* `SearchBudgetRecord` (ppm shares sum to 1) — automated
families must name the `proposer` allocation facet (D5). Split
canaries are committable only under a declared `RolloutPolicy`; the
transition row carries `exploratory`, `comparable: false`, and the
`assignment_seed`; veto/abort settles land `reverted`.

**`adaptive_search` — the three gated strategies.** `voi_weighted`
(5.5) is joined by `disagreement_weighted` (realized-variance arm) and
`successive_halving` (bracket pruning); the engine mints
`inclusion_probabilities` / `halving_bracket` rows
(`charged_to = instrument`) before picking — the record is the draw's
source of truth, INV-9 replay-stable; touched reports carry
`estimated{estimator, ref}` (ADR-0156 D4). All three confine to
`adaptive_search` designs on {search, dev} labels —
`AdaptiveOutsideSearch` otherwise.

**`predictor` (R-2.6.4⁴).** The compute-policy variant is admitted via
`policy_for`; inert (`Unchanged`) without a declared
`SearchBudgetRecord` slice; claimed estimates stamp
`delta_p.source = online` + `claimed`/`sbr:*` evidence refs;
drift-reset cells score nothing (`predictor.drift_reset:*` stamped);
`budget_share_cap` overrun degrades, never binds. Scheduling-rule
targets are tightening-only (`classify_compute_rule_delta`).

**§5c legs.** `CorpusSpec.layers` — a closed vocabulary;
`memory_lineage` carries `LineageLink`s into `EvidenceCorpus` (the
propose input); `memory:`-prefixed evidence refs require the declared
layer; held-out/private/secrets layer names refuse `HeldOutLeak` (S0)
/`CorpusUnreadable` (proposer boundary). The guideline-optimisation leg
is the proposer's `Text`-member rewrite; the debt manager's `home_for`
covers `harness_rule.assumption_debt` (layout rules' debt home).

## Decisions

**ADR-0322** — proposer-as-source (D1); construction-pinned class (D2);
coordination-loosening refusal (D3); `memory_lineage` as a corpus layer
(D4); declared `SearchBudgetRecord` slices (D5); record-then-pick
adaptive dispatch (D6); the OOP fixture witness (D7); the
`hh-registry` kernel-side edge (D8).
